failure_summary.description: Agents missed or misapplied the latest request, including its intended domain, cached base results, or newly supplied constraints.
The agent invented missing hotel dates and skipped a separately actionable restaurant search.
Search or refinement results were not consistently bound and saved to cache.
The agent made unnecessary or invalid calls, including a nearest-results call without the required two result domains.
The round trip was treated as one outbound search instead of separate outbound and return legs.

patch.reasoning: The recurring errors are already addressed by the skill’s instructions on conversation deltas, cache coverage and saving, mandatory inputs, direct tool use, and separate flight legs. Similar clarifications were rejected in earlier steps, so adding more overlapping rules is not warranted.
